paragraphs.text: The Riverside Food Bank needs volunteers to sort donations and pack food parcels. Shifts last three hours, and volunteers must be at least 16. No experience is needed, and training is given on the first day.

Hope House, a care home for older people, is looking for volunteers to chat with residents and help with activities such as quizzes and gardening. Volunteers must agree to visit at least once a week for six months.
The Town Museum wants volunteers to welcome visitors and lead tours. Volunteers should have an interest in local history and must attend a two-day course before they start.
Hope House and the Town Museum both ask volunteers for the names of two people who can recommend them. The Food Bank is the only one of the three that offers weekend shifts.
Anyone interested in any of these roles should first contact the volunteer centre, which is based in the town library.

items.prompt: has a minimum age for volunteers
is the only one with weekend work
involves outdoor activities with the people it cares for
